title: machine-user/1: the machine user's role, as GitHub answered the Maintainer's read of it. It holds write, never maintain or admin, on every repo, through an org role on the code owners' team, with no grant repo by repo (issue 89). What a ruling fixed is a const; the rest is recorded as read. tools/machine_user_drift.sh compares the live role with this file, by hand, and nothing in `make verify` reads GitHub. Two repos are left out by name, the canary and the proof of concept's, as nothing here names them; the org role holds there as everywhere.

teams.description: The teams it belongs to: the code owners' team, which makes it a code owner, and the one every member is in. Nothing is granted to it directly

name.description: The org role the code owners' team holds: write, on every repo

team_repo_grants.description: How many repos the team has a grant of its own on: none, so the org role alone governs

role.description: Its role there, as GitHub's `role_name` says

team_permission.description: The code owners' team's permission there. A team must itself have write to count as a code owner
